headline: Turkish Carmakers Fight EU Trade Investigation into Hybrid Cars
summary: The Turkish automotive sector launched defensive measures against a European Union safeguard investigation into hybrid vehicle imports, which was initiated against China but also threatens Turkish exports.
why: The automotive sector is Turkey's leading export manufacturing industry. EU tariffs on hybrid vehicles would restrict Turkish assembly plants producing for European markets.

impacts.name: Turkish Automotive Exporters
impacts.why: EU safeguard probes risk applying penal import tariffs to hybrid cars manufactured in Turkey.
